rule: Floor = seeded room assembly. Loop runs width*height times. Slot 0 entrance hall; slot 1 secret floor or treasure room; slot 2 shop when shop floor; slot 3 treasure room when secret exit; slot 4 special room if pool non-empty; other slots draw a room from a pool with repeats; a room type is dropped only when no free location fits it. Location budget = 30 + roll%10 capped by free spots. Each location: 1/2 normal branch (loot/monster by player-count divisor 4/3/2/2, default 2; loot 1/10 gold else item; monster 1/10 NPC above depth 1, automaton 3/4 above depth 15); 1/2 decoration branch (1/4 deeper, always on depth 10 or less without custom traps; not on Hell). Gold pile = 10 + roll%100 + depth. Region monster table per map name (Mines 10 buckets, Citadel 15, Labyrinth 20, Hell 20, Swamp/Ruins/Underworld 10, Caves 15, fortress 4), fallback skeleton. Shop floor 1/2 after floor 1 (not Underworld, Hell, fortress). Minotaur floors: 1/2 on depth mod 5 = 2 or 3 below 25, 2 or 4 above 25. Secret exit fixed per floor (2, 3 at 1/2, 7, 8, 11, 13, 16, 18, 23, 28, 33).

look_test: Floor strip at 375 wide: one seed, one player and three players; each floor is a row of about 35 dots coloured monster, loot, gold, decoration or empty. Dom judges whether three players feel crowded (about 9 monsters against 4) and whether the entrance and reward at the start of the row read as a route. Second: a five-slot route card (entry, treasure, shop, special, pool) for three floors.
